clue.text: African soldier raised stink

indicators.note: in a down clue raised means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: GI is an American soldier
BO, body odour, is a stink

explanation.surface: A soldier from Africa kicks up a fuss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' reverses the soldier, which suits a down clue, read from the bottom upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The Igbo are a people of south-eastern Nigeria, so a member of them is an African.

clue.text: Remix of Oasis and Nirvana's first legendary lyricist

indicators.note: a remix rearranges a track, so the band name's letters are rearranged
first asks for the opening letter of the band name that follows

explanation.surface: A mash-up of two 1990s rock bands' songs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Remix of' rearranges OASIS into OSSIA; 'first' adds the N of Nirvana.
explanation.definitionFit: Ossian was the legendary Gaelic bard whose poems James Macpherson claimed to translate.

clue.text: Verse in Nordic translation in dated dress

indicators.note: in places the line of verse within the rearranged letters
a translation turns words into new forms, so the letters of Nordic are rearranged

parts.note: a line is a unit of verse

explanation.surface: A Scandinavian poem rendered into English, about old-fashioned clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'translation' rearranges NORDIC as CRINOD, and the verse line sits after its fifth letter; the final 'in' belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Wearing a crinoline, the hooped petticoat of Victorian times, is being dressed in an outdated style.

clue.text: Spotted mushroom ascending into heaven

indicators.note: into places the climbing fungus inside the word for heaven

parts.note: the sky is poetically heaven

indicators.note: in a down clue ascending means the word is read upwards, from the bottom

parts.note: a cep is an edible mushroom, the porcino

explanation.surface: A speckled mushroom rising up to the skies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ascending' turns CEP into PEC, which goes 'into' SKY. SPECKY is British slang for wearing spectacles, but here it means spotty.
explanation.definitionFit: Specky can mean speckled, covered with small spots, a synonym of spotted.

clue.text: One taking exception to bad job given alternative to shock treatment

indicators.note: bad means the word job is spoilt and its letters jumbled

parts.note: ECT is electroconvulsive therapy, a shock treatment
or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: Someone protesting at a poor deal in which electric shock therapy is offered as an option.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' rearranges JOB as OBJ. ECT, electroconvulsive therapy, is a once-common shock treatment for depression.
explanation.definitionFit: An objector is someone who objects, that is, takes exception to something.

clue.text: Pay attention to stain

definitions.meaning: a blemish or spot left on something

explanation.definitionFit: Mark is a verb for heeding something and a noun for a smudge or blot.

clue.text: State that's acceptable to priest keeping house

parts.note: OK means acceptable

indicators.note: keeping means the priest holds the house inside himself

parts.note: a lama is a Tibetan Buddhist priest

explanation.surface: A place that a clergyman finds agreeable while he looks after a home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeping' gives LAHOMA. HO for house is a standard abbreviation, as in property listings.
explanation.definitionFit: Oklahoma is one of the states of the USA.

clue.text: Present servicemen to ambassador

parts.note: HE, His Excellency, is how an ambassador is styled
RE, the Royal Engineers, are British army servicemen

explanation.surface: Soldiers being presented to a diplomat.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'servicemen to ambassador' puts RE under HE.
explanation.definitionFit: Here, in the sense of in attendance, is a synonym of present.

clue.text: Retracted complaint about a tantrum in haunt of bons vivants

indicators.note: about means the reversed complaint goes round the other letters
retracted, drawn back, tells us to read the word for complaint backwards

parts.note: a bug is a minor illness, a complaint
a strop is a fit of bad temper, a tantrum

explanation.surface: Someone withdraws a moan about a fit of temper at a fancy restaurant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retracted' gives GUB, which goes 'about' the tantrum. A strop is British slang for a sulk or tantrum.
explanation.definitionFit: A gastropub is a pub serving fine food, the kind of place gourmets frequent.

clue.text: An imposing animal twisted joint

indicators.note: twisted means the letters are rearranged

parts.note: an elk is a large, imposing deer

explanation.surface: A large beast has hurt its leg.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twisted' scrambles only the deer, not the opening word; 'imposing animal' reads as a description of a beast but stands for one particular large deer.
explanation.definitionFit: The ankle is the joint between the foot and the leg.

clue.text: Headless halfwit — one bagged by hunter

indicators.note: bagged by means one piece is captured inside the other
headless means the first letter is removed

parts.note: a moron is a halfwit
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A dim-witted man without a head is caught by a hunter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Headless' takes M from MORON to leave ORON; 'bagged by' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Orion is the mighty hunter of Greek myth, now a constellation.

clue.text: Vet's partner gets clincher

parts.note: to vet is to check
a mate is a partner

explanation.surface: An animal doctor's spouse wins the argument.
explanation.definitionFit: Checkmate ends a chess game, so figuratively it is a decisive, winning move.

clue.text: 10 play false, incurring retribution

indicators.note: false means the letters are reworked into a fraudulent order

parts.note: the number ten written as a word

explanation.surface: A team plays foul and is punished.
explanation.walkthrough: '10' is read as the number TEN, not as a reference to 10-across; 'false' rearranges TEN plus PLAY.
explanation.definitionFit: A penalty is a punishment, the retribution for a wrongdoing.

clue.text: Model conundrum

definitions.meaning: someone who poses, for an artist or a camera

explanation.definitionFit: A poser is both a person posing for a picture and a baffling puzzle.

clue.text: Strive to keep arbiter in clover

indicators.note: to keep means the effort word holds the official inside it

parts.note: to toil is to strive
a ref, referee, is an arbiter

explanation.surface: An umpire works hard to stay prosperous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to keep' signals the container. 'in clover' looks like the idiom for living well, but 'in' is a link and clover the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Trefoil is a name for plants of the clover family, with three-part leaves.

clue.text: Writing up feature about wounded revolutionary's shield

indicators.note: about means the reversed feature goes round the other letters
in a down clue writing up means the word is set down from the bottom upwards

parts.note: the nose is a facial feature
cut means wounded
Che Guevara is the archetypal revolutionary

explanation.surface: A journalist describes a facial feature on a hurt rebel's coat of arms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Writing up' reverses the feature to ESON in this down clue, and 'about' wraps it round the rest. Che Guevara stands for any revolutionary.
explanation.definitionFit: An escutcheon is the shield on which a coat of arms is displayed.

clue.text: Position conducive to contemplation of flower?

definitions.meaning: the cross-legged posture used in yoga and meditation
a water lily sacred in Asia

explanation.definitionFit: The lotus position is a meditation posture, and the lotus is also an aquatic flowering plant.

clue.text: Turning North American to South American woman

parts.note: US means American

indicators.note: turning means the letters are read backwards

explanation.surface: A northern American changes into a South American.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turning' makes NA into AN, which goes on the end of S and US.
explanation.definitionFit: Susan is a woman's first name.

clue.text: Faith school in French city erected by a railway

indicators.note: erected in a down clue means the city name is put up from the bottom

parts.note: Nimes is a city in southern France

explanation.surface: A religious school built in a French city by a railway line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'erected' turns NIMES into SEMIN, followed by A and RY.
explanation.definitionFit: A seminary is a college that trains priests, a school of faith.

clue.text: Batterer coming back to do damage

indicators.note: coming back means the word is read in the reverse direction

parts.note: a ram, as in battering ram, batters

explanation.surface: An abuser returns to cause harm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming back' turns RAM into MAR.
explanation.definitionFit: To mar is to spoil or damage something.

clue.text: Seasonal fare from the London Eye?

definitions.text: Seasonal fare from the London Eye?

parts.words: Seasonal fare from the London Eye?
parts.note: a Christmas pastry, which in Cockney rhyming slang is the word for an eye, so a Londoner's eye

explanation.surface: Food served at Christmas on the big wheel by the Thames.
explanation.walkthrough: The London Eye is a big observation wheel, but the clue means a Londoner's eye: in Cockney rhyming slang, words from London's East End, 'mince pies' means eyes.
explanation.definitionFit: Mince pies are small pastries eaten at Christmas, and Cockney slang for eyes.

clue.text: Idle talk about end of siren song

indicators.note: about means the talk goes round the letter

parts.note: chat is idle talk

indicators.note: end of picks the final letter of the word siren

explanation.surface: Gossip about the end of a siren's song.
explanation.walkthrough: 'end of' gives the N of siren, which goes inside CHAT.
explanation.definitionFit: A chant is a repeated, sung melody, a kind of song.

clue.text: Restraining a loony, moved fast — fast!

indicators.note: restraining means one word holds the others inside it

parts.note: ran means moved fast
mad means loony

explanation.surface: A madman rushes along, then fasts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Restraining' signals the container. The first 'fast' is about speed; the second is the definition, abstaining from food.
explanation.definitionFit: Ramadan is the Muslim month of fasting from dawn to dusk.

clue.text: Profits from soaks' drinking vessel

indicators.note: drinking means one word takes in the other

parts.note: to ret is to soak flax in water, so rets means soaks
an urn is a vessel

explanation.surface: Drunks' tankard as a source of gain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drinking' signals the container. 'soaks' looks like drunks, but it is the verb ret, to soak flax or hemp.
explanation.definitionFit: Returns are the yields or profits from an investment.

clue.text: Antelope's knockout booze-up

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the pieces are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: beer is booze

explanation.surface: A drinking spree knocks the antelope out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns KO BEER into REEBOK. 'Antelope's' is 'antelope is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A reebok, or rhebok, is a small South African antelope.

clue.text: Ferocious avian charge on hill

parts.note: a rap is a criminal charge
a tor is a rocky hill

explanation.surface: A savage bird attacks on a hill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' just links: in a down clue the first piece sits on top of the second. A tor is a rocky hill, typical of Dartmoor in England.
explanation.definitionFit: A raptor is a bird of prey, a ferocious hunting bird.

clue.text: Element of skin disorder keeping sane insane

indicators.note: keeping means the disorder holds the other letters

parts.note: mange is a skin disease of animals

indicators.note: insane means the letters of sane are disordered

explanation.surface: Part of a skin condition is keeping a sane person mad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'insane' rearranges the clue's own word as ANES, and 'keeping' signals that the skin disease holds it.
explanation.definitionFit: Manganese is a metallic chemical element.

clue.text: Legion born within 31 days

indicators.note: within means the letter is inside the month

parts.note: May is a month of 31 days
N, from Latin natus, is an abbreviation for born

explanation.surface: A legion was born in a single month.
explanation.walkthrough: 'within' puts N inside MAY.
explanation.definitionFit: Legion as an adjective means numerous, the same sense as many.

clue.text: Top copy given sign of affection

parts.note: to ape is to copy
X is a kiss at the end of a letter

explanation.surface: Best duplicate gets a kiss.
explanation.definitionFit: The apex is the very top or peak of something.

clue.text: Dwarf finding poppy heads in grass

indicators.note: in places the two letters inside the dried grass

parts.note: hay is dried grass
the heads, here the P letters, of poppy: a plural, so two P letters

explanation.surface: A small man finds flowers in a meadow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heads' is plural, so the poppy gives two Ps. Happy is one of the seven dwarfs in the Snow White story.
explanation.definitionFit: Happy is one of the seven dwarfs in the fairy tale of Snow White.

clue.text: Plaything of two foreshortened solvers

indicators.note: two means the shortened word appears twice
foreshortened means the word loses its end

parts.note: the clue speaks to the solvers, you

explanation.surface: A toy for a couple of short puzzlers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'foreshortened' takes the U from YOU; 'two' doubles YO.
explanation.definitionFit: A yo-yo is a toy spool spun up and down on a string.

clue.text: Health worker casting runes

indicators.note: runes are cast like dice, and casting throws the letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A medic tells fortunes by throwing runic stones.
explanation.walkthrough: 'casting' rearranges RUNES.
explanation.definitionFit: A nurse is a medical carer, a health worker.

clue.text: Compiler, self-effacing, keeps no record of artistic study

parts.note: the setter, who compiles the puzzle, refers to themselves as I

indicators.note: keeps means the shy word holds the other letters

parts.note: coy means modest or self-effacing
taken as written
a log is a record

explanation.surface: The modest compiler keeps no record of art history.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Compiler, self-effacing' looks like one idea but splits into two pieces, the setter's I and a word for modest; 'keeps' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Iconology is the study of visual images and symbols in art.
